newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-NANTES DEFENDER PIGNOL JOINS FRENCH CHAMPIONS MONACO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NANTES DEFENDER PIGNOL JOINS FRENCH CHAMPIONS MONACO.

text.p: Defender Christophe Pignol signed a three-year contract with French league champions Monaco on Monday in a move from fellow first division Nantes, the club said.
Pignol, 27, was a regular first-choice player for Nantes and is expected to take over the slot vacated at Monaco by Emmanuel Petit, who joined English premier league Arsenal last week.
The transfer fee is said to be 15 millions francs ($2.6 million).
